channel.title: Humanoids Daily
channel.description: We bring you the latest developments in robotics, with a special focus on humanoid robots and intelligent machines. From groundbreaking research to real-world applications, we cover the people, technologies, and innovations shaping the future of robotics.

item.title: Tesla App Code Hints at Optimus Charging and Home Integration
item.description: A decompilation of Tesla app 4.61.0 identifies Optimus charger IDs and an energy-site entry, suggesting software preparation without confirming a consumer launch.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: GPT-6 Astra Rarely Refused Unsafe Robot Commands in New Test
item.description: RoboHarm adds a safety test to Astra’s robotics results: 97 attempts and 60 completions across 100 unsafe-instruction trials, with only two safety refusals.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: 1X Aims to Ship 50,000 Robots—But Keeping Them Working Is the Test
item.description: Bernt Børnich outlines 1X’s shipment ambitions, a mix of home and enterprise deployments, and why he expects broader robot intelligence to gain ground in 2027.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla Reportedly Begins New Optimus Supplier Audits in China
item.description: Reports point to a new round of Optimus supplier inspections in Ningbo, while company representatives confirm ongoing robotics work but stop short of verifying the latest visits.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Spirit AI Predicts a Robot-Brain Breakthrough in 2027
item.description: Co-founder Gao Yang expects a mid-2027 leap in robots’ ability to follow spoken instructions, while warning that useful household robots remain much further away.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: UBTECH Brings Walker C1 to Slovenia in Balkan Expansion Push
item.description: Walker C1’s Slovenian showcase follows a five-country distribution and integration agreement with Hiproject, adding to Chinese humanoid makers’ European presence.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla’s Optimus Factory Nears a Steel-Frame Milestone in Texas
item.description: A new drone update shows steel and concrete work advancing at Tesla’s Texas robot factory, while production timing remains less certain than the construction progress.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Watney Raises $80 Million to Put Robots to Work in Data Centers
item.description: Watney’s Series A takes funding above $100 million as it targets data-center work, starting with cabling, and claims more than 99.99% reliability.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Lumos Says NexCore Can Teach Robots New Skills in Days
item.description: Lumos pitches NexCore as a faster route from task descriptions to factory-ready robot skills, citing Mitsubishi Electric applications but offering limited benchmark detail.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Brett Adcock Says Figure 04 Will Be Figure’s Biggest Hardware Leap
item.description: On RoboStrategy, Figure’s CEO outlines four chapters for humanoid robotics, explains the limits of Helix 2.5 and teases a major Figure 04 redesign.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Figure’s Helix 2.5 Takes on Chores in 30 Unseen Homes
item.description: Figure reports 56% full-task success for Helix 2.5 across 30 unfamiliar homes, testing whether human-data pretraining transfers to household chores.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: XPENG’s XPACE Trains IRON With Human Videos and Simulated Mistakes
item.description: XPENG’s XPACE combines human demonstrations and simulated recoveries to improve IRON’s manipulation skills, with gains in small real-robot tests.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: KIST Chief Says Korea Can Join the US and China as a Humanoid Power
item.description: KIST’s president sees a path to a three-way humanoid race. Korea’s KAPEX and research strategy support that ambition, while Europe is pursuing its own industrial route.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AGIBOT Says A3 Ultra Is Going to Work in Hotels, Shops and Metro Inspection
item.description: AGIBOT’s latest promotional video highlights A3 Ultra deployments across service and inspection settings, with custom development still part of the equation.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Boston Dynamics IPO Unlikely in 2027, Hyundai Executive Says
item.description: Reuters reports that a 2027 listing is unlikely. Hyundai’s published Atlas roadmap puts scaled factory applications later in the decade.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Unitree Says It Won’t Become a Robot Integration Company
item.description: Unitree’s industrial solutions lead says it will focus on robots and core components, leaving a key question about who delivers complete factory applications.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Unitree’s Stock Slump Puts China’s Robot IPOs Under Scrutiny
item.description: Unitree is down 44% from its debut close. Reports point to closer scrutiny of robotics IPOs, but confirmed listing postponements remain elusive.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agility’s Digit 5 Reveal Includes a Wheeled Robot Concept
item.description: Animations spotted in Agility’s Digit 5 launch material have a written counterpart: its website lists a Wheeled Base Concept. Product details remain unannounced.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: GPT-6 Is Beating Specialist Models in Robotics Tests
item.description: GPT-6 Astra leads specialist models on selected simulation tasks. New robot-arm demos add to the promise, while tougher tests expose its limits.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Unitree’s AI models explained: UniFoLM, WLA and X2
item.description: From autonomous sparring to handling laundry, Unitree is building the AI behind its humanoids. Here is how its UniFoLM models differ—and what developers can actually download.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: RoboStrategy: Our Investment in Maven Robotics
item.description: RoboStrategy’s Jack Pearson explains why the firm led Maven Robotics’ Series A, outlining its thesis on industrial teams, enterprise deployment, and general-purpose robotics.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Rhoda Tests Whether Scaling Web-Video Pretraining Makes Robots Better at Real Work
item.description: Rhoda’s latest study puts video pretraining to an industrial test, adding evidence to the debate over how robots should learn.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Odyssey Unveils Odyssey-3, With Flexion Building Humanoid Control on Its World Model
item.description: Flexion has built humanoid policies on Odyssey’s new foundation world model using tens of hours of teleoperation data, with reported gains in resilience to lighting changes.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Uncaged: Agility CEO Peggy Johnson and Co-Founder Jonathan Hurst Detail Digit 5 Architecture, AI Stack, and Supply Chains
item.description: Hours after introducing Digit 5, Agility leadership unpacked the technical and commercial mechanics behind breaking the safety cage, from 360-degree vision failsafes to a four-layer physical AI stack.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: The UMI Effect: Why Robotics Companies Are Building the Data Collector First
item.description: From a handheld GoPro gripper to Sunday’s Skill Capture Glove, Reward AI’s Omnibody Hand and X Square’s TwinDEX, a growing school of robot development starts with the device humans use to teach the machine.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agility unveils Digit 5, designed to work closer to people
item.description: Agility’s Digit 5 adds a 50 lb payload, nine-minute charging and a new safety architecture. Early access is planned for 2027, with EU and UK deployment ahead.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Reward AI Exits Stealth with OM-1, Pitching Zero-Shot Human-to-Robot Manipulation
item.description: Spun out of Stanford’s DexCap project, Reward AI has introduced OM-1, an embodied foundation model trained exclusively on wearable human data that transfers zero-shot across arms and humanoids.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Munich stealth startup shows walking humanoid “Kyle,” targets early 2027 reveal
item.description: Synapticon co-founder Nikolai Ensslen’s new venture has shown its humanoid development platform, with former DeepMind researcher Oliver Groth on the team.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Brett Adcock’s vehicle clip echoes Figure 03’s delivery demo
item.description: A short clip of a Figure robot stepping out of a vehicle recalls its earlier parcel-delivery footage, but no delivery service has been announced in the post.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Unitree launches G1+ with stronger motors, a moving neck and a $15,000 price
item.description: Unitree’s G1+ adds two neck joints, stronger motors and revised sensing. The base model lists at $15,000 before tax and shipping.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)
